user: Search Verta documentation: for a purchase where the goods never arrived, which exact dispute reason code applies? Reply with that code only. Do not open a dispute.

fragments.text:
Reason code guide
## Choosing a code
The reason code must match what actually happened. A dispute filed under the
wrong code is declined and must be refiled, which may push it past its window.

Payment dispute rules
## Reason codes and chargeback windows
Each reason code has a window in days from the transaction date. A dispute opened after the window closes is not eligible.

| Reason code | Window (days) |
|---|---|
| fraud_card_not_present | 120 |
| goods_not_received | 90 |
| duplicate_charge | 60 |
| service_not_rendered | 90 |
| unauthorized_debit | 56 |

Reason code guide
## goods_not_received
Used when a purchase was paid for but never delivered. Evidence: the expected
delivery date and any merchant correspondence.

Reason code guide
## duplicate_charge
Used when the same purchase was debited more than once. Evidence: references of
both transactions. This code carries the shortest window of the purchase codes.
